page.overview:
Who is Aldreda Tavelle?

Aldreda Seriblo, previously known as Aldreda Tavelle, is a tiefling woman and the younger sister of Lucien Tavelle.

Aldreda was a beautiful tiefling woman with red eyes, magenta skin and black hair styled in braids through which her horns speared.

In her youth Aldreda had a dreamy nature, and aspired to build a successful life. Over the years, she became more suspicious, protecting what she had achieved and distrusting possible changes.

Aldreda was born in 811 PD as the third and youngest child (and the only daughter) of a married couple of the Greying Wildlands. She had two older brothers, Elric and Lucien, the latter being only one year her senior. Their parents were artists who usually played music while their children danced, sang or performed plays, Aldreda being particularly good and singing and dancing, twirling for minutes without getting dizzy; however, their parents were abusive, hitting Elric despite being the best performer, while Lucien tried to protect himself and his sister. Things got worse after Elric was killed due to a debt with the Jagentoth family, and Lucien's parents, obsessed with getting their best performer back, talked to a witch in the Savalirwood, Azrahari, who turned Elric's corpse into a strange puppet that his parents kept around, horrifying their other two children, and even using the puppet to support their arguments, like when Aldreda criticized how they performed a certain play.thumb|200px| At some point Lucien couldn't stay there any longer, so he burned down the caravan with his parents and the puppet inside, and he left with his sister. She, eventually, travelled to Rexxentrum under the promise of working cleaning houses until she could find a powerful husband or lover; she wrote to Lucien from time to time, and he expected to eventually move in with her when the time was right.
